note: Switchable texture styles. Godot: K or the pause menu (game/scripts/styles.gd), remembered in settings.cfg [visuals] texture_style. BeamNG: export option --texture-style (baked into the facade textures). A style is offered only when all its textures exist in game/assets/textures (built by its import tool from a pack the owner downloaded). Geometry and world never change with the style.
